svg.title: Context Memory lifecycle: main loop and same-task pause/resume
svg.desc: A compact source-grounded diagram of AgentController.submit through ContextManager, attach_context, Agent.run, pre_llm, assembled Context Memory, LLM.generate, tool execution, ToolResult, post_tool and observe, the Coordinator/Worker memory split, and the same task_id AskCoordinatorTool pause/resume loop.
svg.text: 先看蓝色主循环；橙色是 Worker-only 暂停，紫色沿同一 task_id 恢复并回到 Agent.run。

g.text: observe / prune / assemble bypass；system + raw messages 透传。
① pre_llm: prepare → refresh → prune → assemble
⑤ episodic: no Worker-style episodic list
⑥ worker-only mailbox / team: not maintained here
① pre_llm: team fetch → refresh → prune → assemble
③ pinned: position / inventory / current task
⑥ recent window remains in the assembled prompt
暂停 · Worker-only exception → INPUT_REQUIRED / help_request
恢复 · same task_id → pending tool result → Agent.run continuation
no new user turn when call is pending
